units.title: Introduction to AutoCAD
topics: 1.1. File menu of AutoCAD with New, Open, Save, Save as and Close
1.2. Basic 2D commands like Line, Circle, Ellipse, Multi Line ,Construction Line, Polyline, Point, Donut, Ellipse, Polygon, Rectangle, Arc
1.3. Erase, Snap, Redraw, Regenerate , Zoom, Pan
uos: 1.a. Demonstrate the basics of AutoCAD software and its important commands
1.b. Prepare a simple building drawing file using basic draw and modify commands

units.title: Editing of AutoCAD Drawing
topics: 2.5. Block, WBlock, Insert and Explode , Area
uos: 2.a. Explain the applications of Edit commands
2.c. Apply advanced command for edit /modification of drawing

units.title: Advanced 2DCommands
topics: 3.1. Application of LAYER command in Civil Engineering
3.2. Layer command with its all sub commands, Line type, Color

3.3. Dimension command – linea , aligned, arc length, radius, Diameter, Centre, Leader, Baseline and Continuous Dimensioning,tolerance, override and Dimension updates Text and DTEXT commands with Text Style Hatch command
uos: 3.a. Prepare typical Drawings using Different Layers
3.b. Develop final Drawings with Dimension and Text and Hatching

units.title: 3D Commands of AutoCAD
topics: 4.1. Units, Elevation, Thickness, UCS and UCS Icon
4.2. Viewports , Extrude , 3D Solids – Sphere, Box, Cylinder, Cone, Wedge, Interference
4.3. 3D Surface – Revolved, Tabulated and Ruled Surfaces

4.4. Hide, Render and Shade of 3D drawings Computer Aided Drafting Course code: 3340606 GTU/NITTTR/Bhopal/13-14 Gujarat State 3 Unit Major Learning Outcomes (in Cognitive Domain ) Topics and Sub-topics
uos: 4.a. Use 3D commands to generate 3d view from 2D drawing
4.b. Prepare 3D Drawings using 3D Commands of AutoCAD

units.title: Plot of 2D & 3D Drawings
topics: 5.1. PLAN , ELEVATION and 3D Views of Residential and Commercial Building
5.2. PLOT and its Sub Command for Plotting Drawing on A1, A2 and A3 Size Paper using Printer and / or Plotter
uos: 5.a. Setup printer , plotter for printing of drawings
5.b. Plot 2D and 3D Civil Engineering Drawings as per requirement on different scale and sizes
